name: Montana
sources: MT DOR, 'HB 337' news release (revenue.mt.gov/news/recent-news/HB-337): 2026 rates 4.7% / 5.65%, thresholds $47,500 / $71,250 / $95,000; capital gains rates stay 3.0% / 4.1% with brackets matched to the ordinary thresholds
MT DOR, 2025 Tax Rates and Deductions: capital gains stacked on ordinary income; 65-and-over subtraction $5,660

MT DOR, Montana Tax Simplification Resource Hub and 2024 Tax Simplification webinar: starts from federal taxable income; net long-term capital gains as in IRC 1222, qualified dividends taxed as ordinary income
provisional: 65-and-over subtraction is the 2025 amount ($5,660 per person); the 2026 inflation-adjusted figure is not published
Capital gains thresholds are inferred to equal the 2026 ordinary thresholds; the DOR says they match but does not list them
notes: Montana adds back the federal qualified business income deduction; this estimate does not, so it may be low for self-employed filers.
